Steeveyboy/feature-creep.title: Require a signed-off PRD before `suggestFeature()` may suggest a feature
Steeveyboy/feature-creep.user_story: As a director of product operations, I want `src/core.js` to block `suggestFeature()` until a product requirements document has been approved in the options page, so that our feature suggestions are themselves properly suggested.
Steeveyboy/feature-creep.why_now: The README says reliability matters more than features, yet `extension/content.js` currently lets any individual contributor click the button with zero governance. Every unreviewed click is roadmap risk.
acceptance_criteria: `extension/options.html` gains a 14-field PRD form with a mandatory 'Strategic Alignment' section
`suggestFeature()` in `src/core.js` rejects with `PRD_NOT_APPROVED` until two stakeholders have signed off
`config.js` gains a `spinnerMessages` entry reading 'Awaiting sign-off...' that is shown for a minimum of three business days
`scripts/try.mjs` supports a `--skip-governance` flag that is documented as deprecated on release

torvalds/linux.title: Add NPS survey prompt to `panic()` before the system halts
torvalds/linux.user_story: As a kernel product owner, I want `panic()` in `kernel/panic.c` to ask the user 'How likely are you to recommend Linux to a friend or colleague?' before halting, so that we capture sentiment at the moment of peak engagement.
torvalds/linux.why_now: The `MAINTAINERS` file lists thousands of people but not a single owner for customer satisfaction. A kernel panic is our highest-attention touchpoint and today we let it end without a call to action.
acceptance_criteria: `kernel/panic.c` renders a 0 to 10 scale on the console and waits up to 30 seconds for a keypress
Responses are persisted through `fs/pstore` so the score survives the reboot
A new `Documentation/admin-guide/nps.rst` explains how detractors are followed up
`scripts/checkpatch.pl` warns on any new `panic()` call site that lacks a survey question

facebook/react.title: Add a loading spinner while `useState` decides on the initial state
facebook/react.user_story: As a frontend engineer, I want `useState` in `packages/react/src/ReactHooks.js` to display a branded loading spinner while it resolves its initial value, so that users feel reassured something is happening during those microseconds.
facebook/react.why_now: The README promises that React makes it 'painless to create interactive UIs', but state initialization currently offers no visual feedback at all. Competitors are shipping skeleton screens for far less.
acceptance_criteria: `useState` accepts an optional third return value, `isDeciding`, that is always `false`
A spinner is committed by `packages/react-reconciler/src/ReactFiberWorkLoop.js` and removed in the same tick
The spinner is configurable through a new `<StateLoadingProvider>` wrapped around the whole app
`packages/react/README.md` documents the feature under a new 'Delight' heading
